instructions: Each item is one phrase that a paper wrote inside \text{...} in a formula. Decide what it does in that formula: 'condition' when it is the condition of {x | ...}, 'proposition' when it is a whole statement such as one side of an \iff, 'predicate' for a verb or relation such as 'has rank' or 'is mapped to', 'guard'/'consequent' for the two halves of an if-then, 'scope' for a quantifier, 'connective' for and/or, 'restriction' for 'where', 'default' for 'otherwise', 'label' for a name used inside a subscript, 'text' for running words that carry no structure. 'sig' is the normalised phrase, so the same answer is reused in other papers.

answer_meaning.label: a name inside a subscript
answer_meaning.operator: an upright name that is a function
